					set_variable = { name = zg361_we_al_external_receipt_state value = 4 }

					set_variable = { name = zg361_we_al_external_last_operation value = 359 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_we_awaiting_al_357_359 value = 0 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 3594 } }
			}
			else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 3593 } }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 3572 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_al_external_stage_receipts_verified var:zg361_we_al_external_stage_receipts_verified = 1 var:zg361_case_al_state >= 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 2 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_status value = 4 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason value = 3571 } }
}
